rationale: The workflow already applies the dependency-cache optimization supported by the measured cache experiments: actions/setup-java@v5 is configured with cache: "gradle", which caches Gradle dependencies/wrapper. Adding a separate actions/cache step would duplicate an equivalent cache, which is a stated contraindication of P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. No matrix exists for fail-fast; there is no schedule trigger for schedule-related patterns; ci_history reports no completed runs / not a measured baseline, so the precondition for a history-based custom timeout is unmet and an arbitrary timeout could break valid slow builds (contraindication). Other patterns would either require new network access/separate workflows (cancel-stale), reduce required-check coverage (change-filter, test/build selection), or lack identified output consumers (unused outputs). Build and test coverage is preserved, and no supported minimal change applies.
